title: Globulin

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

sources.title: MedlinePlus: Total Protein and Albumin/Globulin (A/G) Ratio

measures: Globulins are a group of blood proteins that help fight infection and move nutrients through the body. Some are made by the liver and others by the immune system.
context: Globulin is usually calculated from total protein and albumin, and read together with the A/G ratio.
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
